commands.name: critical-areas
commands.description: Describe what is critical in this project (no text: show it; "clear": remove it)
commands.output:
Nothing marked as critical in this project yet.
Run /critical-areas <what is critical here>, e.g. /critical-areas pricing and tax rules, anything in src/billing, database migrations

commands.name: critical-list
commands.description: List the critical decisions recorded in this session
commands.output: No critical decisions recorded in this session.

commands.name: critical-ok
commands.description: Dismiss the critical decisions shown above the prompt

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record every decision you make mid-task, without the user asking for it literally, that changes something the user marked as critical in this project (see "Critical decisions" in the system prompt). The user is warned right away.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: ./register.tsx hooks: session.start, command.run{command=critical-areas}, prompt.compose, command.run{command=critical-list}, command.run{command=critical-ok}, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}, tool.call{tool=?}, tool.call, turn.complete

./register.tsx hooks on prompt.compose do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them
